edge: Create a deliberate same-region race to confirm that no particular source order is a language guarantee.
notes: A conformance case must not demand one of the permitted arbitrary orders.
positive: Use independent Active-region events and accept every result permitted by either processing order.

edge: Use a delayed nonblocking assignment and verify its NBA event occurs in the specified later time slot.
positive: Execute a zero-delay nonblocking assignment in the active region set and verify its update is delivered through the current-slot NBA region.

edge: Schedule additional Active events before #0 and verify the suspended process resumes only after those current Active events.
positive: Execute #0 between two observable process actions and verify the latter resumes through a subsequent Inactive-to-Active iteration of the same slot.

edge: Interleave another concurrent process while verifying the block's own statement order remains unchanged.
positive: Perform dependent blocking assignments in one begin-end block and verify source-order results.

edge: Use a network where omitting one connected driver would change the resolved value, and verify that driver participates.
positive: Connect multiple interacting bidirectional devices and verify node values reflect the complete connected network.

edge: Compare #0 from Active with #0 from Reactive to verify Inactive versus Re-Inactive resumption.
positive: Change an indexed target selector during a blocking intra-assignment delay and verify RHS uses initiation-time values while target selection uses resume-time values.

edge: Use an x-controlled network whose conducting and nonconducting interpretations disagree and verify x.
positive: Drive a tranif network with x control where all switch interpretations yield one node value and verify that value.

edge: Compare it with an Active-region effect at the same callback time.
positive: Register cbAfterDelay and verify it observes and may affect state before Active events.

edge: Compare its observation with cbReadOnlySynch in the same slot.
positive: Register cbAtEndOfSimTime and verify it runs after other iterative regions but before Postponed observations.

edge: Queue several same-slot NBA updates while checking only the cross-region boundary.
positive: Register cbNBASynch with a pending NBA and verify callback observation precedes the NBA update.

edge: Use a next time slot containing pending Active activity.
positive: Register cbNextSimTime and verify invocation before Active events of the next simulation time.

edge: Compare its observation with cbAtEndOfSimTime in the same slot.
positive: Register cbReadOnlySynch and verify it observes final same-slot settled values in Postponed.

edge: Use a pending NBA and classify the callback observation as one of the two allowed placements.
notes: The oracle must accept both mapped regions; requires a PLI callback harness.
positive: Register cbReadWriteSynch and accept execution at either permitted NBA boundary.

edge: Observe a slot with immediate Active updates.
positive: Register cbAtStartOfSimTime and verify invocation before Active activity in that slot.

edge: Use an implicit port continuous assignment of a constant.
positive: Drive a target from a constant continuous assignment and verify propagation at time zero without a source transition.

edge: Use an implicit port-connection continuous assignment and verify equivalent scheduling.
positive: Change a continuous-assignment source and verify the target updates from current expression values.

edge: Add synchronization to remove the race and then require the settled value.
notes: A case should accept both legal outcomes rather than require the simulator to exhibit both.
positive: Reproduce the same-slot continuous-assignment/display race and accept either explicitly permitted displayed value.

edge: Deactivate corresponding assignments affecting multiple selected targets where legal.
positive: Release a forced target and verify subsequent source changes are no longer governed by that force.

edge: Create additional Active activity during processing and verify Inactive processing waits until Active activity is exhausted.
positive: Schedule observable Active- and Inactive-region effects in one time slot and verify the Active effect precedes the Inactive effect.

edge: Exercise supply strength and verify the specified supply-to-strong exception.
positive: Drive an inout connection from each side and verify bidirectional net resolution without ordinary strength reduction.

edge: Connect an expression rather than a simple net and verify equivalent behavior.
positive: Change an outside expression connected to an input and verify the local input follows continuous-assignment semantics.

edge: Create multiple Inactive iterations and verify NBA processing waits until Inactive activity is exhausted.
positive: Schedule observable Inactive- and NBA-region effects in one time slot and verify the Inactive effect precedes the NBA effect.

edge: Derive execution order through legal process interleaving rather than assuming source order across processes.
positive: Execute two same-time nonblocking assignments to one variable sequentially and verify the second value is final.

edge: Queue multiple NBAs while changing selectors between statements and verify each retains its own captured value and target.
positive: Queue an NBA, then change both its RHS source and indexed LHS selector; verify the queued value updates the originally captured target.

edge: Use an explicit zero delay and verify it remains in the current time step rather than advancing simulation time.
positive: Compare a zero-delay NBA with a nonzero-delay NBA and verify their updates occur in the current and specified future time steps, respectively.

edge: Combine same-slot design NBA activity with a property action and verify the action executes only after Observed evaluation.
positive: Trigger a concurrent assertion and verify its pass or fail action executes as Reactive-region activity in the same time slot.

edge: Compare #1step sampling at a time-slot boundary with current-slot sampling.
positive: Change a signal in the current slot and verify a #1step clocking-block input observes its value from immediately before that slot.

edge: Connect an output expression to an outside variable where legal.
positive: Change a local output expression and verify the connected outside object follows continuous-assignment semantics.

edge: Verify the explicitly registered one-shot callback is not repeatedly invoked without re-registration.
positive: Register one activity-triggered callback and one one-shot callback and verify each uses its defined execution kind.

edge: Compare $display with $strobe around a same-slot nonblocking update.
positive: Update a value earlier in a slot and verify $strobe reports its settled Postponed-region value.

edge: From Postponed, schedule permitted future-time activity and verify it does not change a value in the current slot.
negative: From a Postponed callback, attempt to write a net or variable and require rejection without depending on diagnostic wording.
notes: Requires a callback/API harness capable of attempting a Postponed write.

edge: Compare a writable Pre-Postponed callback with a Postponed read-only callback.
negative: Attempt a value-changing operation from the Postponed callback and require rejection without depending on diagnostic wording.
positive: Use a Postponed read-only callback to observe the final settled value for a time slot.

edge: Create an event from Pre-Active and distinguish it from one created after Active processing.
positive: Write through a Pre-Active callback and verify Active-region code sees the updated value.

edge: Create an event at Pre-NBA while an NBA update is pending.
positive: Read or write in Pre-NBA and verify the operation precedes a pending NBA update.

edge: Write or create an event immediately before Postponed and check resulting legal scheduling.
positive: Read in Pre-Postponed and observe effects settled through all earlier regions.

edge: Compare a direct 1-bit-net input with an expression input.
positive: Connect a primitive input to a compound expression and verify updates propagate through continuous-assignment semantics.

edge: Compare a direct 1-bit structural net expression with another expression that requires an implicit net.
positive: Connect a primitive input directly to a 1-bit net and verify strength-sensitive behavior without implicit conversion.

edge: Race an independent Active event while accepting allowed same-region order.
positive: Change primitive inputs and verify its output net updates as Active-region activity.

edge: Use a legal 1-bit structural net expression and verify direct strength behavior.
negative: Connect a primitive output to a non-1-bit or nonstructural expression and require rejection.
positive: Connect a primitive output and inout directly to 1-bit nets and observe their drive without intervening strength conversion.

edge: Change multiple expression sources in one slot and check the update uses current values.
positive: Activate a procedural assign or force, change a source, and verify the target actively updates.

edge: Use statements without # or @ controls and avoid assuming that each whole statement is an indivisible scheduler event.
notes: A case must not demand that a permitted suspension or a particular interleaving be exhibited.
positive: Use independent concurrent procedural activity and accept every result permitted by suspension and interleaving while checking each block's internal-order invariant.

edge: Contrast property sampling with Observed-region evaluation so the oracle isolates evaluation placement.
positive: Trigger a concurrent property around a same-slot NBA update and verify evaluation uses the state available in Observed.

edge: Create additional Reactive activity and verify Re-Inactive waits until Reactive activity is exhausted.
positive: Schedule observable Reactive and Re-Inactive effects in one slot and verify Reactive precedes Re-Inactive.

edge: Create multiple Re-Inactive iterations and verify Re-NBA waits until Re-Inactive activity is exhausted.
positive: Schedule observable Re-Inactive and Re-NBA effects in one slot and verify Re-Inactive precedes Re-NBA.

edge: Create a deliberate Reactive-region race and confirm that no source order is treated as guaranteed.
notes: A case must not require one permitted order.
positive: Use independent Reactive-region events and accept every result permitted by either processing order.

edge: Compare their effects with design Active-region activity while making no assumption about order within Reactive.
positive: Run checker or program blocking-assignment code and concurrent-assertion action code and verify each is Reactive-region activity.

edge: Use a delayed reactive-set nonblocking assignment and verify its Re-NBA update occurs at the specified later time.
positive: Execute a zero-delay nonblocking assignment from program activity and verify its update is delivered through current-slot Re-NBA.

edge: Schedule additional Reactive activity and verify the suspended process resumes only after current Reactive events.
positive: Execute #0 in program or checker code and verify resumption through the next Re-Inactive-to-Reactive iteration in the same slot.

edge: Have reactive activity create several kinds of reactive-set events and verify the complete set drains before new Active processing.
notes: Observe only ordering exposed by language constructs.
positive: Schedule cascading reactive-set events and verify that earlier-region iteration does not resume until all five reactive-set regions are empty.

edge: Change an inout actual while the task is active and distinguish invocation-time copy-in from return-time copy-out.
positive: Call a task with output and inout arguments, alter the formals, and verify the actuals update on return as blocking assignments.

edge: Schedule new same-time events while processing a slot and verify they complete before time advances.
notes: Same-region ordering may be nondeterministic and should not be assumed.
positive: Schedule observable effects at two nonzero delays and verify the earlier time slot completes before the later one.

edge: Create multiple events in one region while relying only on order between regions.
notes: Materialization should use constructs whose region assignment is specified; order within a region may be unconstrained.
positive: Arrange observations in constructs assigned to different defined regions and verify the guaranteed cross-region order.

edge: Drive control with x and z and verify both are treated as off, unlike built-in-net switch semantics.
positive: Connect two user-defined nets through a controlled bidirectional switch and verify combined resolution for on and separate resolution for off.

edge: Have both sensitive processes produce independent effects so the test does not assume an order between them.
notes: Do not use a race-dependent final value as the oracle because consideration order is arbitrary.
positive: Change a signal observed by two sensitive processes and verify that both processes evaluate.
